content: {"reasoning": "The claim was denied CO-197 for missing prior authorization, which this payer requires and does not offer retroactively, nor does it offer peer-to-peer review. A medical-necessity appeal was already filed and cannot overcome an administrative auth failure, and resubmitting would draw a CO-18 duplicate denial. CO-197 (missing auth) is provider liability, so the balance cannot be shifted to the patient; with all payer avenues exhausted, the correct closure is to write off.", "action": "write_off"}
